Based on a visual inspection of the provided UI, here are the measurable defects:

1.  **Truncated Header Text**: At the very top of the first card, the header row is vertically clipped by the top edge of the container, cutting off the top half of the text (likely "Timebucket", "Value", and "Source").
2.  **Clipped Chart Element**: In the "Elevation profile" section, the rightmost point of the elevation line graph extends beyond the right boundary of the chart's plotting area/viewport.
